evidence: Adds wallet_taproot_decaying_multisig_descriptor_psbt.py to test wallet PSBT signing and Miniscript descriptor workflows.
rationale: Adds end-to-end test coverage for wallet PSBT workflows combining a MuSig2 aggregate key path with timelocked Miniscript script paths across watch-only and single-key signer wallets. While worthwhile for verifying complex descriptor wallet interactions, it fixes no bugs and addresses no critical fund safety defects.
